DEFINE INSTRUMENT ILL_D2B(
  double lambda = 1.594,
  double DM = 0,
  string Powder = "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
  double RV = -1,
  double L1 = 16.05,
  double L2 = 2.645,
  double L3 = 1.3,
  int verbose = 1,
  double ALPHA1 = 18,
  double ALPHA2 = 11,
  double ALPHA3 = 5,
  double ETA = 12,
  double THETA_M = 67.5,
  double TILT = 0,
  double SM = 1,
  double Dheight = 0.3,
  double coating = 0
)

DECLARE
%{
  char lamopts[128];
  double L;
  double KI, Vi, EI;
  double ALPHA3_Opt;
  double U, V, W, L0;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  if (!THETA_M && lambda && DM)
    THETA_M = asin(lambda/(2*DM))*RAD2DEG;
  else if (THETA_M && !lambda && DM)
    lambda = fabs(sin(THETA_M*DEG2RAD))*2*DM;
  else if (THETA_M && lambda)
    DM = fabs(lambda/sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M)/2.0);
  THETA_M *= SM; /* take-off direction left or right */
  if (!THETA_M || !DM || !lambda) {
    fprintf(stderr, "ILL_D2B: ERROR: Monochromator take-off, d-spacing or wavelength is null (THETA_M=%g, DM=%g, lambda=%g). Abort.\n", THETA_M, DM, lambda);
    exit(1);
  }
  if (!L1)    L = L2;
  else        L = 1/(1/L1+1/L2);
  if (RV < 0) RV=2*L*sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M);
  KI = 2*PI/lambda;
  Vi = K2V*fabs(KI);
  EI = VS2E*Vi*Vi;
  if (ALPHA1<0)  ALPHA1=600;
  if (ALPHA2<0)  ALPHA2=600;
  if (ALPHA3<0)  ALPHA3=600;
  if (ETA<=0)    ETA   =30;
  U = 4*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ETA*ETA + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD)*tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  V = 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 +2*ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  W = ALPHA3*ALPHA3+(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
                   /(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  L0 = (ALPHA1*ETA*ALPHA2*ALPHA3/tan(fabs(THETA_M)*DEG2RAD))
     / sqrt(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  ALPHA3_Opt = 1/sqrt(1/ALPHA1/ALPHA1+1/ALPHA2/ALPHA2+1/ETA/ETA);
  if (verbose) {
    printf("ILL_D2B: Detailed DIF configuration\n");
    printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\n",
      lambda, EI, KI, Vi);
    printf("* Monochromator:  DM=%.4g [Angs] RV=%.4g [m] %s, take-off 2*THETA_M=%.4g [deg]\n",
      DM, RV, (!RV ? "flat" : "curved"), THETA_M*2);
    printf("* Resolution:     Caglioti              U=%g V=%g W=%g [deg^2]\n", U/60/60, V/60/60, W/60/60);
    printf("                  Optimal          ALPHA3=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt);
    printf("                  Optimal resolution A1/2=%g [min]\n",  ALPHA3_Opt/sqrt(2));
    printf("                  Normalized Intensity L0=%g [min^3]\n", L0);
  }
  RV = fabs(RV)*SM;
  sprintf(lamopts, "lambda limits=[%g, %g]",lambda*0.99, lambda*1.01);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
    radius = 0.11, dist = 11,
    focus_xw = fabs(0.05*fabs(sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M))), focus_yh = 0.3,
    lambda0 = lambda, dlambda = lambda*0.01,
    I1 = 0.5874e+13, T1 = 683.7, T2 = 257.7, I2 = 2.5099e+13, T3 = 16.7, I3 = 1.0343e+12)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win0 = Slit(radius = 0.11)
AT (0, 0, 2.462) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Oct1 = Slit(xwidth = 0.15, yheight = 0.15)
AT (0, 0, 2.512) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Oct2 = Slit(xwidth = 0.177, yheight = 0.177)
AT (0, 0, 2.512) RELATIVE Origin ROTATED (0, 0, 45) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win1 = Slit(radius = 0.0565)
AT (0, 0, 3.5321) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win2 = Slit(radius = 0.0555)
AT (0, 0, 4.0421) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win3 = Slit(radius = 0.0575)
AT (0, 0, 4.087) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win4 = Slit(radius = 0.0575)
AT (0, 0, 4.999) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win5 = Slit(radius = 0.0625)
AT (0, 0, 5.006) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Win6 = Slit(radius = 0.0625)
AT (0, 0, 5.151) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT SMguide = Guide(w1 = 0.07, h1 = 0.3, l = 5, m = coating)
WHEN (coating > 0)
AT (0, 0, 11) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Alpha_One = Collimator_linear(
    xwidth = 0.07, yheight = 0.30, length = 0.70, divergence = ALPHA1, transmission = 1.0)
WHEN (ALPHA1 > 0)
AT (0, 0, L1 - 1.045) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Slit_Mono = Slit(xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.3)
AT (0, 0, L1 - 0.1) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_XY = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3, bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1, options = "x y")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Slit_Mono

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA1_Div = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3, bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1, options = "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D2B_Mono_XY

COMPONENT D2B_Mono_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.1, yheight = 0.3, bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1, options = lamopts)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA1_Div

COMPONENT mono_cradle = Arm()
AT (0, 0, L1) RELATIVE Origin

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT Monok = Monochromator_curved(
    NH = 1, NV = 28, mosaich = ETA, mosaicv = 12, RV = RV, DM = DM, width = 0.1, height = 0.3)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED (0, THETA_M + TILT, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT sphere = PSD_monitor_4PI(filename = "sphere", radius = 0.5, restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT mono_out = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle ROTATED (0, 2 * THETA_M, 0) RELATIVE mono_cradle

COMPONENT Shield_Hole = Guide_channeled(
    w1 = 0.05, h1 = 0.274, w2 = 0.044, h2 = 0.201, l = 0.752, R0 = 0, nslit = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0.304) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Alpha_Two = Collimator_linear(
    xwidth = 0.05, yheight = 0.2, length = 0.2, divergence = ALPHA2, transmission = 1.0)
WHEN (ALPHA2 > 0)
AT (0, 0, L2 - 0.25) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Slit_Sample = Slit(xwidth = 0.01, yheight = 0.05)
AT (0, 0, L2 - 0.02) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT D2B_ALPHA2_Div = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.05, bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1, options = "dx limits=[-0.5 0.5] dy limits=[-1 1]")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Slit_Sample

COMPONENT D2B_Sample_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth = 0.02, yheight = 0.05, bins = 40, restore_neutron = 1, options = lamopts)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D2B_ALPHA2_Div

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT Arm_Sample = Arm()
AT (0, 0, L2) RELATIVE mono_out

COMPONENT Container_in = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.0025 + 0.00051, yheight = 0.04, thickness = 0.0005,
    d_phi = RAD2DEG * atan2(Dheight + 0.05, L3), p_interact = 0.1, concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT Sample = PowderN(
    reflections = Powder, radius = 0.0025, yheight = 0.04,
    d_phi = RAD2DEG * atan2(Dheight + 0.05, L3))
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT Container_out = PowderN(
    reflections = "V.lau", radius = 0.0025 + 0.00051, yheight = 0.04, thickness = 0.0005,
    d_phi = RAD2DEG * atan2(Dheight + 0.05, L3), p_interact = 0.1, concentric = 1)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Arm_Sample

COMPONENT collimador_radial = Collimator_radial(
    yheight = Dheight, length = 0.30, divergence = ALPHA3, theta_min = -165, theta_max = -5,
    radius = L3 - 0.3 - 0.01, verbose = 1, approx = 1)
WHEN (ALPHA3 > 0)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaTheta = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = Dheight, restore_neutron = 1, radius = L3,
    options = "banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaThetaCenter = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = 0.1, restore_neutron = 1, radius = L3,
    options = "banana, angle limits=[5 165], bins=3200")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample

COMPONENT D2B_BananaPSD = Monitor_nD(
    yheight = Dheight, radius = L3 * 1.005,
    options = "banana, theta limits=[-165 -5] bins=320, y bins=25")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample

END
